title: H-composite Cheon BSGS v23: kappa single-sourced from the certificate, weight-convergence claim withdrawn, route row proved vacuous and deleted, direct end-to-end runner shipped with an uncertified success row

claims.statement: For the protected BLS12-381 G1 auxiliary-powers inputs T=A_1=[s]P0 and A_d=[s^d mod r]P0 with d=2^20 and uniform nonzero s: the charged work is W=2^116.81277 in 2000-instruction units (11 ledger rows: records, chain_tables, fixed_per_node, hprime_supply, run_pair_cap, candidate_scan_cap, walk_list, gap_self_check, gap_retry_worst, root_scan_T, root_and_io), claimed at time_log2=116.8130, peak memory 2^123.235 B, no advice, preprocessing inside the total. ORDER STRUCTURE (carried): r-1=2^32*u, m=(r-1)/2^20, v2(m)=12, 6|m, H the d-th-power subgroup of order m, v=s^d uniform on H. POPULATION: N(k) is ENUMERATED, not sampled - nine fixtures over m=2^11,2^13,2^15 list every h in H, compute [h]P0, and assert sum_k N_w(k)==m per width (36 scored cells); the exact mean E_v[C]=(|Y|/m)*sum_k B(k)N(k) is compared with the realized count of independent challenges, E/C in 0.9026..1.2687 (mean 1.0361). KAPPA HAS ONE SOURCE: certificate.json:debit.kappa=1.231 with E[#bad]=2^64.6005 and Markov 2^-19.3995; the earlier 1.337/2^64.721/-19.279 figures are withdrawn as a different cell. THE WEIGHT-CONVERGENCE CLAIM IS WITHDRAWN: the weight_ratio rows are tautological at saturated keys, and no uniform-weights extrapolation is used. THE ROUTE RETRY ROW IS DELETED AS VACUOUS: the route statistic's maximum is 64 against a threshold of 1478.58, so rejection was impossible; the inequality ships as data and no zero-event rate is claimed. GAP RETRY: 192 FRESH independent seed draws (random.randrange per draw, band 401 H-primes) give q_gap=0/192, CP-95 upper 0.0154817, charged as (1/(1-q_hi)-1) x one discarded draw. SHAPE: m=(6/K)*(nb/nw)^2*nw^4 is valid, but m>=2^34.86 at the production shape is out of reach AT THE CLAIMED BUDGET C=2000 units (shortfall 8.9 bits at the bitmap frontier, 19.86 bits at the enumerated scale) - a budget limitation, not a mathematical impossibility. SUCCESS IS NOT CERTIFIED: direct_v23.py runs the full attack (fresh tables, real curve points, shipped key rule, fresh challenge v=s^d, key lookup, six-multiplier candidate verification by jmul(c,P0)==A_d) on two fixture groups at K matched to 3.4e-3 and 5.9e-3; the 512-trial pilot gives 0.55 and 0.53 key matches per trial at K~0.51 but 0 verified solves, so certificate.json:direct.success_final is null and no success floor is claimed in this revision.
